test_binary_slice_basic: test the binary slice operation with positive offset and length on a polars DataFrame column
test_binary_slice_negative_offset: test the binary slice operation with a negative offset on binary data
test_binary_slice_to_end: test the binary slice operation with only an offset to extract data to the end
test_binary_slice_with_expression: test the binary slice operation using a column expression as the offset argument
test_binary_head_basic: test the binary head operation to extract the first n bytes from a binary column
test_binary_tail_basic: test the binary tail operation to extract the last n bytes from a binary column
test_binary_head_then_tail: test chaining binary head and tail operations to extract a middle segment of bytes
test_binary_slice_then_head: test chaining binary slice and head operations on a polars DataFrame column
test_binary_tail_then_slice: test chaining binary tail and slice operations to extract a middle segment of bytes
